title.zh: 材料准备接入重复链状生成
title.en: Prepared material joins recurrent chain formation

statement.en: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units run exactly when the stock covers d·k(2^n − 1), ending with k·2^n units; from k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k·2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1).
statement.zh: 每个单位从同一存量取 d 并一分为二时，自 k 个单位的 n 轮运行，恰当存量覆盖 d·k(2^n − 1)，终于 k·2^n 个单位；自 k 条成熟链、池中有各轮所需组分块时，n 轮达到 k·2^n 条成熟链，恰当支持覆盖 9k(2^n − 1)。

laws.en: For every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws, a copy of a word makes its product what was built followed by the word exactly when the pool supplies the word and the support covers what its attachments draw.
laws.zh: 对每个有可判定相等的字母表与每条汲取律：词的复制使产物成为已建者接上该词，恰当池供给该词且支持覆盖其接合所取。

laws.en: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly when d·k(2^n − 1) ≤ m, ending with k·2^n units and m − d·k(2^n − 1) of the stock, and they run wherever the stock covers that; k(2^n − 1), what the rounds draw for beyond the start, with the k units of the start makes k·2^n.
laws.zh: 每个单位从同一存量取 d 并一分为二时：自 k 个单位、存量 m 的 n 轮运行，恰当 d·k(2^n − 1) ≤ m，终于 k·2^n 个单位与存量所余 m − d·k(2^n − 1)，存量覆盖它处便运行；轮次在起点之外所取的 k(2^n − 1) 加上起点的 k 个单位为 k·2^n。

laws.en: In the chain machine, end attachment of up to eight tokens is the core copy of the alternating word with unit draws: within the size limit a chain grows by the alternating word exactly when the pool supplies that word and the support covers one unit per token; attachment keeps a chain's bonds the path on its tokens, so a chain so bonded grows exactly so, bonds included.
laws.zh: 在链机中，至多八个记号的末端接合是单位汲取下交替词的核心复制：在长度上限内，链按交替词生长，恰当池供给该词且支持每个记号覆盖一个单位；接合保持链的键为其记号上的路径，所以如此成键的链恰在同样条件下生长（含键）。

laws.en: From the empty chain the mature chain of eight alternating tokens forms, bonds included, exactly when the pool holds at least four of each kind and at least eight units of support are free.
laws.zh: 自空链形成八个交替记号的成熟链（含键），恰当池中两类各至少四个且至少八个单位支持空闲。

laws.en: Each attachment and each cleavage draws one unit, so the support used grows by the tokens added plus the chains added, in one reproduction and over rounds. From k mature chains with the blocks for n rounds in the pool, the rounds reach k·2^n mature chains exactly when the free support covers 9k(2^n − 1), that is, exactly when doubling with draw 9 runs n rounds from k units and the free support.
laws.zh: 每次接合与每次切分各取一个单位，所以在一次复制与多轮中，所用支持的增加等于所增记号加所增链数。自 k 条成熟链、池中有 n 轮所需组分块时，诸轮达到 k·2^n 条成熟链，恰当自由支持覆盖 9k(2^n − 1)，即恰当取量为 9 的加倍自 k 个单位与该自由支持运行 n 轮。

laws.en: With the blocks for n rounds and any tail in the pool and the free support raised by 9k(2^n − 1), n rounds from k mature chains give k·2^n mature chains, leaving the tail and the free support, the sufficient side; in the machine's own count k(2^n − 1) and k make k·2^n, and every course of rounds keeps the tokens in chains and pool together and the free and used support together.
laws.zh: 池中有 n 轮所需组分块加任意尾部、自由支持增加 9k(2^n − 1) 时，自 k 条成熟链的 n 轮得到 k·2^n 条成熟链，余下尾部与原自由支持：即充分一侧；按该机自身的计数 k(2^n − 1) 加 k 为 k·2^n；每段轮次进程都保持链与池中记号的总数，以及自由与已用支持之和。

laws.en: Where routing the eight-slot recipe from a pool completes with nothing left, the routed output with the blocks for n rounds and any tail in the pool and 9(2^n − 1) + 8 more units of free support forms the mature chain and then 2^n mature chains, leaving the tail and the free support.
laws.zh: 从某池路由八槽配方完成且无剩余时，路由的输出加池中 n 轮所需组分块与任意尾部、再加 9(2^n − 1) + 8 个单位自由支持，先形成成熟链，再形成 2^n 条成熟链，余下尾部与原自由支持。

laws.en: The mature chain's tokens and bonds are those of the earlier fragmentation chain, and cleaving it at its centre leaves two alternating fragments of four that keep their internal bonds, the earlier chain's cut components.
laws.zh: 成熟链的记号与键即此前碎裂链的记号与键；在中心切分它，留下两个保留内部键的四记号交替片段，即此前链的切分分量。

laws.en: In witnesses: two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 27 units of support give four mature chains, while with 26 the last successor has seven components, all material kept; and from a pool of eight tokens of one kind with eight units, growth stalls after one token with seven units free.
laws.zh: 见证：自一条成熟链、有三条链所需组分块与 27 个单位支持的两轮得到四条成熟链；支持为 26 时最后一个后继只有七个组分，材料全部保留；自只含一类八个记号的池与八个单位，生长在一个记号后停滞，七个单位空闲。

hypotheses.zh: A/B 末端相容、八组分路径的中心切分及操作次序给定；初始已完成路由输出没有未表示承重边。
hypotheses.en: A/B end compatibility, central cleavage of an eight-component path and operation order are supplied; the completed routing output has no unrepresented load-bearing edges.

hypotheses.zh: 一条完整链继续 g 轮另需 8(2^g−1) 组分和 9(2^g−1) 支持；从路由材料激活结构另需八单位支持。
hypotheses.en: Continuing one complete chain for g rounds requires 8(2^g−1) additional components and 9(2^g−1) support; structural activation from routed material additionally requires eight support units.

The core laws hold for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws; the machine's tokens are Boolean, its chains at most eight tokens long, its counts of tokens and support natural numbers.
hypotheses.zh: 核心规律对每个有可判定相等的字母表与每条汲取律成立；该机的记号是布尔值，链至多八个记号长，记号与支持的计数是自然数。

does_not_show.en: Heritable variation of the organizing laws, physical mechanics, an autonomous feed and a broad comparative advantage do not follow from these laws.
does_not_show.zh: 由这些规律推不出组织规律的可遗传变异、真实力学、自供材料或广泛的比较优势。

does_not_show.en: The attachment route and the earlier division growth correspond only at the checked endpoint.
does_not_show.zh: 接合途径与此前的分裂生长只在已核对的端点上对应。

detail.zh: 少一单位支持留下真实七组分后继；缺 B 仍有支持也停滞。
detail.en: One missing support unit leaves a real seven-component successor; absence of B stalls despite remaining work.

validation_scope.zh: 核心 Copying：4.29.1 合并检查器（becoming-checks/），公理报告为空。外围 RecurrentAssembly：目录检查（recurrent-assembly-verification/，4.29.1，新定理31、审计47、闭包373）；CopyingInstances：实例检查（copying-instances-checks/，4.29.1）；至多 propext、Quot.sound、Classical.choice，有的为空。推论有效性与生物对应分列。

next_delta.en: Explain the physical discrimination of chain ends, the renewal of the supply the rounds draw on, and how shared provision is divided among chains.
next_delta.zh: 说明链端的物理辨别、诸轮所取供给的更新，以及共同供给怎样在链之间划分。

correspondence.zh: 结构由实际移入、形成边、过滤旧边及保留片段构成。新接合途径与旧分裂生长仅有已检查的端点对应。
correspondence.en: Structure consists of actual token transfers, formed edges, filtered old edges and retained fragments. The new attachment route and old division growth have only the checked endpoint correspondence.

detail.zh: prepared_repeated_generation 使用 completed_routing_output 和既有 route_trace_projection 接通。
detail.en: prepared_repeated_generation uses completed_routing_output and the inherited route_trace_projection to compose the interface.

output.zh: 成功路由轨迹的实际 placed 序列。
output.en: Actual placed sequence from a successful routing trace.

input.zh: 逐项接合的共享材料池。
input.en: Shared component pool for tokenwise attachment.

conditions.zh: 给定路由能力、无未表示承重边、另供八单位初始接合支持及明示后续库存。
conditions.en: Supplied routing capability, no unrepresented load-bearing edges, eight additional activation-support units and explicit subsequent stock.

detail.zh: formed_graph_matches_previous 与 fragments_retain_real_links 核对已生成图及真实分割；不复用旧概率为长期增长。
detail.en: formed_graph_matches_previous and fragments_retain_real_links check the formed graph and actual split; old probabilities are not reused as long-term growth.

output.zh: 先前实际链状图与中心断裂的成员分割。
output.en: Previous actual chain graph and central-cut member partition.

input.zh: 新接合终点与保留内部连接的片段。
input.en: New attachment endpoint and internally connected fragments.

conditions.zh: 限于已核对链类及两种形成途径的端点对应；不等同局部规律或汲取。
conditions.en: Only the checked chain class and endpoint correspondence between formation routes; local laws and draws are not identified.

detail.en: Copies a template strand, the fragment this formation leaves, token by token from a shared pool.
detail.zh: 从共享池逐记号复制模板链，即本形成留下的片段。

detail.en: Local contact formation entering that copying.
detail.zh: 接入该复制的局部接触形成。
